name: Chlorphenoxamine
summary: Chlorphenoxamine (Phenoxene) is an antihistamine and anticholinergic used as an antipruritic and antiparkinsonian agent. It is an analog of diphenhydramine.

pharmacology.text: Chlorphenoxamine (Phenoxene) is an antihistamine and anticholinergic used as an antipruritic and antiparkinsonian agent.

uses.text: Chlorphenoxamine (Phenoxene) is an antihistamine and anticholinergic used as an antipruritic and antiparkinsonian agent.

sideEffects.en: Common effects include drowsiness, dry mouth, blurred vision, constipation and difficulty urinating. Large amounts can cause confusion, hallucinations, a racing heart, overheating and seizures.
sideEffects.zh: 常見作用包括嗜睡、口乾、視力模糊、便秘與排尿困難。大量使用可能造成意識混亂、幻覺、心跳過快、體溫過高與癲癇發作。
sideEffects.zhHans: 常见作用包括嗜睡、口干、视力模糊、便秘与排尿困难。大量使用可能造成意识混乱、幻觉、心跳过快、体温过高与癫痫发作。

fact.en: It is diphenhydramine with a chlorine atom added to one ring and a methyl group added to the central carbon. Small tweaks like these shift a drug's balance between antihistamine and anticholinergic effects.
fact.zh: 它是在苯海拉明的一個環上加了氯原子，並在中心碳上加了甲基。這類小改動會改變藥物在抗組織胺與抗膽鹼作用之間的平衡。
fact.zhHans: 它是在苯海拉明的一个环上加了氯原子，并在中心碳上加了甲基。这类小改动会改变药物在抗组织胺与抗胆碱作用之间的平衡。
